current_answer: Choose by the frontend job, not by the skill name. For a checkout, registration, or data-entry flow where fields, validation, errors, and recovery are the bottleneck, Hueyexe Forms, Inputs, and Checkout is a conditional fit: its current mutable instructions give a specific form-design workflow, but Codex loading and outcomes are untested. For a browser-game HUD, use OpenAI Game UI Frontend only when playfield and input boundaries are the problem. Use PaulRBerg Frontend Design for one project-bound direction on an existing screen, Product Design Ideate for three pre-build image directions, and Frontend App Builder for concept-to-browser work. Other lanes remain distinct: Anthropic and PracticalSwan for visual direction and stateful design, Wenkang for human visual feedback, Vercel skills for React composition, transitions, review, and performance, Agent Browser and Dogfood for capture or exploratory QA, Frontend Testing & Debugging for a named rendered change, and Product Design Audit for a captured flow. Eleven of sixteen listings are source-pinned; five current sources are mutable. None has been independently installed, executed, or compared on a shared frontend task by this pool.
